limits: Inspected development fixtures, not holdout or population certification
Synthetic source claims, not real Hermes speedup evidence
One new typed reporting contract, not a rescue/regrade/causal comparison of v1 or v2
No model necessity, provider-token reduction, latency reduction, or independent outcome verification established by offline checks
Fixture-owned ancillary membership is not a production semantic selector

mutation_axis: Within each fixture, full versus minimal exact EvidenceRef membership. Only the preregistered ancillary telemetry ref is removable.

prospective_live.comparisons: Only two preregistered matched full/minimal pairs (positive and negative); four separate minimal negative controls. No provider attribution when provider identity is null.
prospective_live.driver: Reuse existing native live_baseline/verified_context_cohort driver; no new network client.
record: actual usage and cost including failed calls
prospective_live.route: existing Nous route; root binds catalog and route SHA before any call
prospective_live.status: NOT_IMPLEMENTED_OR_AUTHORIZED; root review and a new execution freeze required
prospective_live.wire_guard: One fixed physical staging/profile path; fresh state per case; archive completed artifacts before next call; compare entire native and forwarded requests with only exact context replaced by sentinel; reject any other difference before forwarding. No template fallback.

qualification: all seven independent fixture outputs match exactly in both arms
full and minimal preserve all pinned evidence byte-exact and contradiction/gap lists exactly
rendered model-visible context contains only evidence, contradictions, unresolved_gaps
deterministic reporter outputs match between arms
all five named wrong-behavior mutants fail at least one oracle control
native Hermes hook/compose witness retains exact context without transport
historical answers, checkers, receipts, and scores remain unchanged

semantics.independence: Tested-source identity status never changes an independently unambiguous scope declaration.
semantics.negative: Only an explicit matching source-declared false reports false. Missing proof does not imply false.
semantics.positive: Matching source-declared true reports true, without establishing real-world truth.
semantics.prose: Raw historical prose/provenance retained; typed scope unknown. No universal prose parser.
semantics.trust: Source records carry no execution authority. Typed reporting does not authenticate a producer or resolve undeclared prose conflicts.
semantics.wrong_subject: Even explicit true for another subject gives unknown for requested subject.

task: Exact source-declaration reporting under an explicit typed contract; not actual-world verification
